hooks.command: printf %s '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"coding-discipline PRE-FLIGHT - if this turn begins or continues non-trivial implementation or design work, do this BEFORE writing code: (1) READ the actual code and docs you will touch; map the data flow, layer boundaries, and existing structures to REUSE (no duplicate or near-duplicate logic, no hardcoding, no bypassed chokepoint); (2) for any novel or non-trivial best-way design choice, WEB-RESEARCH the established pattern (design-system, framework, or standard) - do not guess; (3) write the design and key decisions in PROSE, name the pattern, state what you reuse vs build, and CONFIRM with the owner before building; (4) then build in SMALL slices and AUDIT each part (clean, robust, efficient, reliable, final-product fit) before the next. if grep -q 'git commit'; then printf %s '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"coding-discipline POST-FLIGHT - run these BEFORE this commit, not after: (1) self-review the full diff; (2) for any non-trivial or STRUCTURAL change (agent loop, data model, SSE wire, security boundary, shared architecture, a pattern future code will follow), run an INDEPENDENT audit-lens pass - the audit skill - for robustness, efficiency, reliability, edge cases, design fit, and no duplication or hardcoding or bypassed chokepoint; not just leaf edits; (3) verify against a real criterion (build, tests, live), report honestly; (4) strip instrumentation. Trivial fast-path edits: a quick confirm is enough."}}'; fi

(2) SECURITY - run the SECURITY_MODEL.md safe-defaults checklist: bind 127.0.0.1, debug off, Tailscale Serve HTTPS is the only ingress, shell.user_exec/agent_exec set as intended, no secrets tracked in git. (3) WHICH procedure: UPDATING an already-deployed prod = deploy/linux/README.md section Release, end-to-end: pick a verified sha -> semver tag + push -> WAIT for the CI release gate green (gh run watch) -> re-pin ~/apps/ctrl-b at the tag -> install.sh prod -> verify (git describe --exact-match must print the tag; the version field in /api/health is the package version, NOT the tag).
